description: Declares the three rendering audiences for ERP Forge spec documents. Each profile controls which fields and sections are included in output, and provides format hints for the renderer.

profiles.description: Human-readable business summary for customer review and sign-off. Strips all technical implementation details.

format_hints.audience_note: This document describes what we are building for you. Please review and confirm before development begins.

profiles.description: Full technical specification for Claude Code and developers. Includes all sections, data shapes, and implementation-specific details.

rendering_notes: Render data entities as TypeScript interface sketches where possible
Render workflow steps as numbered task lists with actor and system labels
Render feature acceptance criteria as checkboxes
Render AI touchpoints with confidence threshold and model preference prominently

profiles.description: Integration-focused view for external developers connecting to the ERP. Shows API conventions, integration endpoints, authentication, and data shapes.

rendering_notes: Render data entity fields as OpenAPI schema objects
Render integration endpoints in OpenAPI path format
Render error and success envelopes as OpenAPI response schemas
Show authentication method and config prominently at the top of each integration section

rendering_rules.field_inclusion_logic: A field is included in a profile if: (a) the field has no _render array (bare field) AND include_bare_fields is true, OR (b) the field has a _render array that contains at least one of the profile's include_render_flags.
rendering_rules.section_inclusion_logic: A section is included if: (a) the section is in sections_to_include (or sections_to_include is absent), AND (b) not in sections_to_exclude, AND (c) the section's _section_render contains at least one of the profile's include_render_flags (or _section_render is absent).
rendering_rules.envelope_unwrapping: When a field is an envelope object (_value, _render, _label, _hint), the renderer must output _value as the field value, using _label as the display key if present, and _hint as tooltip or footnote if present.
rendering_rules.bare_field_passthrough: Bare fields (not wrapped in an envelope) are included for all profiles when include_bare_fields is true.
